metadata.scope: United States-market branded-food references; no Hong Kong price, formulation or complete allergy verification.
metadata.selection: 358 distinct check-digit-valid GTIN reference records retained from two documented publishedDate-descending API searches (crackers and cookies),400 source rows. One previously included record is quarantined for a material native-serving/household-gram conflict. Source LCSL less-than-derived figures and missing values remain unknown for display/ranking. Distinct GTINs can share a product name; the records are not proof of358 unique formulations. Not representative of the whole market or guaranteed newest outside these queried results.

servingBasisConsistencyReview.rule: Only one unambiguous explicit household gram weight is checked. Hold when its difference from native GRM/g serving exceeds both2g and5% of household grams. Counts, volume, ounces, ranges and multiple weights are not inferred.
